facts.reloadOrRetention: Recreate/reconfigure the owning object through its runtime owner; retain journals, locks, identities and migration/retirement boundaries. A path edit does not migrate state.
facts.sensitivity: No credential values are part of this reference; follow named Secret/reference contracts.

limits: Only explicitly mapped checked-in configuration facts; no default global API success, deployment, runtime, live Secret values, or generic parser acceptance.
Historical whole-source failures and unavailable native witnesses remain retained; supported facts require direct source/owner/consumer evidence.
authoredScope: Exact current source/family boundaries plus existing guarded field inventories; independent original closeout remains separate.
scope: Checked-in selected configuration families and bounded source/consumer relations; not global API discovery or live runtime.
